selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_05 high-activation follow-up R115: compose R112 fixed-function pipeline identity with R110/R111 managed-texture stage readiness into one fail-closed non-routing activation-candidate snapshot.
summary: R115 adds a composite DX11 activation-readiness evidence object and deterministic snapshot token that requires both the exact fixed-function pipeline snapshot and all required managed-texture stage snapshots. Untextured candidates are represented explicitly, textured candidates require a nonzero stage snapshot, missing/pending component evidence fails closed, and changing a component identity changes the composite token. This does not enable native draw routing.

risk_review.reason: No protected DX9Ex renderer/HUD/OpenXR risk path was changed. R115 is confined to dormant DX11 readiness composition plus hosted probe/verifier coverage, so hosted CI cannot establish Quest3/VDXR visual correctness.

initial_validation_failure.root_cause: The R115 probe used NativeManagedTextureStageReadiness plus the two composition helpers inside an anonymous namespace but omitted their outrun::vr::dx11 using-imports.
initial_validation_failure.repair_scope: Probe namespace imports only; no R115 readiness logic or runtime routing semantics changed.

openxr_vr_architecture.evidence: All six jobs PASS: host-x64, game-x86, game-x86-safe-draw-compare, game-x86-r26-hud-safe, game-x86-c1-r29-r28-classify, game-x86-c2-r30-hud.

evidence: Both source commits contain the exact controller marker [AUTO:CONVERSION-DX11-00086]; the validation-bearing result commit contains no CI-skip directive.
R115 requires a ready/nonzero R112 pipeline snapshot and exact required texture-stage readiness; required textured stages also require a nonzero R110/R111 stage snapshot.
R115 composite snapshot identity mixes the pipeline token, texture-stage token and required-texture mask, so a component identity change produces a different composite token.
Hosted negative probes confirm missing texture snapshots, pending texture stages and a not-ready pipeline fail closed.
No N100 clone/worktree, PC fast runner, Quest3/VDXR or in-game execution was used.
resume_cursor: R115 is automation-validated but runtime-untested. Composite readiness evidence now prevents independently valid pipeline/resource snapshots from being treated as a complete activation candidate unless both sides are simultaneously ready. Native draw routing remains dormant.
next_action: Continue with the next independent bounded DX11 activation prerequisite or transport-parity gate. Do not promote native draw ownership or claim graphics/runtime correctness before exact-build Quest3/VDXR evidence.
